name: Fieldset
description: Groups related form controls in a native fieldset with a legend, optional description, and an error slot.
designIntent: Radio groups, checkbox groups, and multi-control sections need an accessible group name. Fieldset provides the native <fieldset>/<legend> semantics with token-based styling (borderless by default) plus description and error slots so related controls read as one unit.

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend rendered as the group's accessible name.

props.name: description
props.description: Muted supporting line rendered under the legend.
examples: Applies to every project in this workspace

props.name: error
props.description: Error line rendered under the controls; announced via role=alert.

examples.title: Grouped radio-style options
examples.code:
<Fieldset legend="Export format" description="Applied to every selected row">
  <Checkbox id="csv" /><Label htmlFor="csv">CSV</Label>
  <Checkbox id="json" /><Label htmlFor="json">JSON</Label>
</Fieldset>
examples.description: Legend names the group; description adds context.

examples.title: With a group-level error
examples.code:
<Fieldset legend="Visibility" error="Choose who can see this project">
  <RadioGroupItem value="private" label="Private" />
  <RadioGroupItem value="team" label="Team" />
</Fieldset>
examples.description: Errors that belong to the whole group live on the fieldset, not each control.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use a fieldset for layout grouping
antiPatterns.explanation: Fieldset is for FORM controls that share one accessible name. For purely visual grouping use Card or a plain div — screen readers announce every fieldset as a landmark-ish group and excess ones add noise.

antiPatterns.title: Don't skip the legend
antiPatterns.explanation: A fieldset without legend (or without aria-label) leaves the group unnamed — controls inside lose their grouping context for screen reader users.

accessibility.implementation: Renders <fieldset> with <legend>; the legend is the group's accessible name announced before each control
accessibility.userRequirements: Always pass a legend (or an equivalent aria-label)

accessibility.implementation: The error slot renders with role=alert so it is announced when it appears
accessibility.userRequirements: Keep the message actionable ('Choose at least one option')

guidelines: Phrase as the question or choice name

compositionRules.relationship: Wrap mutually exclusive or multi-select controls so their group name is announced
For a single labeled control prefer FormField; Fieldset is for GROUPS of controls
